scope_limits: Single venue and top-of-book only; not consolidated executable liquidity or full depth.
Kraken response has no provider event timestamp; retrieval time is the observation cutoff.
Response body text was hashed, but HTTP headers and independent wire-byte capture were unavailable.

tradradar_aggregate.methodology_note: The long/short ratio is account-count based, not notional exposure. Liquidation totals are lower bounds because exchanges disclose incomplete real-time liquidation data.

observations.fund_universe: 6 US spot XRP ETFs plus BITW
observations.methodology: Sum of daily changes in issuer-reported XRP holdings; flow-excluded funds count as zero.
caveats: Holdings-derived estimate, not a direct AP cash creation/redemption ledger.
Flow-excluded funds counted as zero can understate or distort a complete universe.
Dollar equivalent is derived using each day's XRP price, not cash proceeds verified from AP records.
A displayed zero is not independently verified AP cash creation/redemption.
Underlying inputs are issuer-published holdings; separate dashboards do not create independent primary-data corroboration.
Fund coverage differs from XRP Insights.

etf_flow_reconciliation.disagreement_reason: Different fund universes, date windows, exclusions and holdings-derived methods. XRP Insights' three-day -259,701 XRP aggregate and Alpha Finance's seven-session +$4.8M aggregate are not the same measurement.

descriptive_only: Kraken last trade was 6.31% below its UTC-day open and 3.81% below its rolling 24-hour VWAP.
TradRadar showed seven-exchange USD open interest down 4.87% while long liquidations materially exceeded short liquidations.
TradRadar's account-based long share remained 80.3% and weighted funding remained positive.
Kraken's own perpetual page showed much smaller venue-specific open interest and near-zero funding; this is not contradictory because the venue universe differs.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: Price weakness, falling aggregate OI and long-heavy liquidations are consistent with leveraged-long deleveraging.
disconfirming_or_missing: TradRadar's account ratio remains heavily long and funding is still positive.
No synchronized trade-level liquidation tape or notional long/short exposure was captured.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: The move may be part of broader crypto or macro risk reduction rather than XRP-specific supply.
disconfirming_or_missing: No synchronized BTC/ETH, dollar, rates and equity factor panel is included in this artifact.

disconfirming_or_missing: ETF aggregators disagree in scope and horizon.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: Differences in OI, ETF flows and venue prices partly reflect coverage, timing and unit differences.
disconfirming_or_missing: The same-time underlying venue snapshots are incomplete, so the size of the measurement effect is unknown.
